description: Gaia Saviors is a Cairo-based team competing in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We build practical solutions using NASA data, AI, Earth observation, and software engineering. Our focus is the MODIS & VIIRS Hot Spots challenge, covering fire detection, tracking, data harmonization, and 3D visualization. We welcome teammates interested in GIS, remote sensing, AI/ML, data science, frontend, 3D, and scientific research.
